module: Coarse 2D occupancy grid (1 m cells) shared by bridge pier clearance and vegetation clearance. Roads (groups with divPoints/binormals) and junctions are supplied to rebuild; the Rail Network posts its tracks and junctions via setRail; everything is stamped together, along with static obstacles (rivers, buildings, fences, lakes), terrain claimed by other tools (groundClaims) and a layer specific to plants (setPlantKeepOut). Each cell keeps an owner (string), or false if several share it. The queries (occupiedAt, transportAt, blocked, overhangAt...) answer "is there something here".
notes: Owners (first character): 'g' road/rail, 'p' path, 'j' junction, 'b' building; suffix 'b' = bridge section of a link (a pier may stand under its own deck), suffix 't' = underground (tunnel, tunnel junction, terrain claimed for cover); rails are 'gr', 'jr'. Plants stand on what is buried, everything else avoids it.
Margins: road ribbons 0.5 m, rivers +1 m beyond the half-width, buildings +1 m, fences 0.5 m, lakes +1 m, claimed terrain 0.5 m; stabilized shoulder counted at constant width.
The queries refresh the grid on demand (freshen): it is restamped if the rail or claims revision has changed. revision() changes on each restamp.
The radius values are 0 if nil. Outside the grid, all queries answer false.
setRivers/setBuildings/setFences/setLakes each replace their list; the lists survive rebuild() so that pier remeshing keeps avoiding them.
Expected structures: rivers { pts = {{x,y},...}, halfW = n }; buildings and lakes = lists of filled {x,y} rings; fences = {x,y} polylines.

rebuild.desc: Restamps the grid from the roads and junctions. Remembers the inputs so that claimed terrain can be stamped later without remeshing the network.

groups.desc: List of groups (roads) with id, divPoints, binormals, divWidths, leftExtM, rightExtM, isEnabled.

clearSegs.desc: clearSegs(g, kind) returns the per-segment mask of a link (false over its spans of this kind, 'bridge' or 'tunnel'), or nil if it has none. Supplied by the network that owns the spans.

returns.desc: true if the point is inside.

blocked.desc: True if a cell of the axis-aligned footprint belongs to an owner outside the cluster. pass(owner), if provided, lets other owners through.

pass.desc: pass(owner) returns true to tolerate this owner.

returns.desc: true if the footprint is blocked.

heightAt.desc: Height of the road (at its point closest to x, y) or of the junction stamped under this owner; nil for any other owner.

roadBetween.desc: True if a road or junction other than skip's (its ownerFor, deck sections included) is stamped within the radius around (x, y) at a height strictly between zLo and zHi.

skip.desc: Owner to ignore (as well as its b and t suffixes).

returns.desc: true if a road lies between these heights.

occupiedAt.desc: True if something is stamped within the radius (all owners, plant layer included) other than underground: a tree stands on the hill above a tunnel. Used for vegetation clearance.

revision.desc: Counter that changes whenever the grid changes: a tool that keeps things off the grid compares this value instead of querying again for each point.

occupiedAtExcluding.desc: Like occupiedAt but IGNORES the cells belonging only to ownerId (the caller's ribbon, deck and tunnel sections included). Does not take the plant layer into account.

returns.desc: true if something else occupies the area.

ownerFor.desc: Owner string of a group ("g" followed by its id), to pass to occupiedAtExcluding.

transportAt.desc: True if a TRANSPORT cell (road 'g', path 'p', junction 'j', or multi-owner cell) lies within the radius.

roadRailAt.desc: Like transportAt but PATHS are ignored: true only for a road or rail ribbon 'g' or a junction 'j' (or a multi-owner cell, kept as a precaution because its owners are lost).

returns.desc: true if a road, rail or junction is present.

overhangAt.desc: True if the center of a road, rail or junction cell, or a BUILT cell of the plant layer, lies within the radius: what a crown of this width would overhang or cross as it grows. A disc (not the box of roadRailAt), exact on shared cells. Blocks with no road or construction are skipped in one go, so a distant point costs a few reads whatever the radius. The filled middle of a junction marks no block, but nothing from outside reaches it without crossing the edge skin, which does mark.

returns.desc: true if a crown of this radius would overhang something.

setPlantKeepOut.desc: Source of the terrain that plants avoid in addition to the rest: get() returns `paved, built` where paved = { { ring = r, holes = { r, ... } }, ... } (a trunk cannot stand there) and built = { r, ... } (a crown cannot reach it either). rev() changes when either changes. Single source; see occupiedAt and overhangAt.

buildingAt.desc: True if a BUILDING cell (owner 'b', stamped footprint + 1 m) lies within the radius.

returns.desc: true if a building is present.

clearClusterCache.desc: Clears the set of allowed owners cached in a cluster (_pierAllow), to be called when the cluster changes.

setRail.desc: Rail Network side: get() returns its tracks (read as road groups), its junction platforms ({ id, pos, lines = { { pts, halfW } } }) and the clearSegs of its tracks; rev() is incremented on each change.

railRev.desc: Rail revision (0 if not registered). Roads restamp the grid themselves once stabilized; rail changes are detected from this revision.

railCluster.desc: Builds the cluster of these under which the piers of a rail bridge may stand, for blocked: the bridge sections of these tracks and these junctions.

setRivers.desc: Registers rivers as static obstacles (importer). Replaces the previous list; the list survives rebuild().

setBuildings.desc: Registers buildings (filled polygons) as static obstacles.

setFences.desc: Registers fences, walls and hedges (thin polylines) as static obstacles.

setLakes.desc: Registers lakes (filled shoreline polygons) as static obstacles.

clearStatics.desc: Clears all static obstacles (rivers, buildings, fences, lakes).
